scientific_integrity: The result is an exact mathematical theorem with an explicit proof conditional on the published 2007 even-hypercube code minimum-distance theorem. Computational tests are finite corroboration, not proof. Priority is provisional and no independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ideal pure graph states; parity cut; even dimension at least four; fault sets are matchings only; no operational noise guarantee or classification of larger fault sets.
title: Sharp matching-fault threshold for checkerboard entanglement on even hypercubes
